title: Domain Registrations: Domain Care Refund Amount on a Grace-Period Renewal Charge
content:
## Calculation sheet — refund amount

**The charge.** Under Domain Registrations, the charge price-matched is the domain's most recent grace-period renewal charge: the grace-period renewal charge line of the domain with the latest charge date. A domain is never billed two such charges on one day, and an older grace-period renewal charge is never price-matched. The refund amount is set for that charge only where it was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025, both days included, and paid by card or PayPal; a most recent grace-period renewal charge billed outside those dates or paid any other way earns no refund under this sheet.

**The amount.** The price-match refund is the charge's Domain Care credits, never more than the amount billed on the charge, rounded half up to the cent, and nothing is refunded where those credits come to zero. The Domain Care credits of the charge are the amounts named as one of the charge's Domain Care credits, added together, each read from the account's records on the day of the price match. Where no Domain Care credit applies to the charge, nothing is refunded.

**The years.** Where a credit is measured for each year the charge covered, the years are those recorded on the charge line.

| Charge in scope? | Credits on the day of the price match | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| yes | more than zero, not above the amount billed | the credits, rounded half up to the cent |
| yes | above the amount billed | the amount billed |
| yes | zero | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

### Hypothetical worked examples

- A grace-period renewal charge of USD 41.20 billed by card on 9 August 2023 for 1 year, with Domain Care credits of USD 2.45 on the day of the price match: refund USD 2.45.
- The same charge with credits of USD 44.00: refund capped at USD 41.20.
- A charge billed on 30 November 2025 by PayPal is in scope; one billed on 1 December 2025, or on 31 December 2021, is not.
- A charge in the date range paid from account credit is not in scope.
